sourceScope: Synthetic compact bedroom with a different cut angle; all dimensions are test selections.
checks: rooms and unequal-angle cuts created through the same forms
straight openings and fixed column validated; cut-corner column rejected atomically
exact net areas, disjoint footprint, clear furniture/swings and native label bounds passed
furniture in cut region warns and correction clears it
invalid cut, excessive diagonal thickness and opening on removed wall rejected atomically
cut removal returns to rectangular geometry; exact undo restores the diagonal
clear furniture and undo retain angled structures
real JSON/2D exports, reload and import preserve the editable model
390px reusable cut form reachable without horizontal overflow
